title: HSK 2.8 · 收到, 重新, 正好, 信心, 不好意思
focus: 气 · 倒 · 欢迎 · 边 · 新闻 · 收 · 重新 · 满 · 身边 · 正确 · 收到 · 正是 · 接着 · 重点 · 级 · 接到 · 提高 · 满意 · 信号 · 心中 · 高中 · 空气 · 相同 · 到处 · 观点 · 高级 · 收入 · 同事 · 信心 · 故意 · 闻 · 放心 · 正好 · 好处 · 重复 · 好事 · 提到 · 不如 · 不好意思
body:
Receiving and correcting things: 收 receive, 接 catch, 提 raise, 正 correct, 重 again/heavy, plus 高 high and 好 good in new combinations. Watch 重: chóng 'again' in 重新/重复 but zhòng 'heavy, important' in 重点.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收 | shōu | to receive, collect | 收, 收到, 收入 |
| 正 | zhèng | straight, correct; just | 正确, 正是, 正好 |
| 重 | chóng / zhòng | again / heavy, important | 重新, 重点, 重复 |
| 高 | gāo | high, tall | 提高, 高中, 高级 |
| 好 | hǎo | good | 正好, 好处, 好事, 不好意思 |
| 心 | xīn | heart | 心中, 信心, 放心 |
| 接 | jiē | to receive, meet, connect (扌 hand) | 接着, 接到 |
| 提 | tí | to lift; to bring up (扌 hand + 是 shì sound) | 提高, 提到 |

## Watch out

- 倒 has two readings: dǎo fall over (摔倒) and dào pour, reverse (倒水).
- 收入 uses 入 rù (enter), not 人 rén (person).
- 闻 wén (hear) is 耳 ear inside 门 door; 问 wèn (ask) is 口 mouth inside 门.

cards.Meaning: air, gas; anger; to make angry
cards.Example: 别生气了。 bié shēngqì le: Don't be angry
cards.Notes: Picture of rising vapor: air, breath, energy. In 天气 weather, 生气 angry, 空气 air

cards.Meaning: to fall over / to pour; upside down
cards.Example: 我给你倒杯水。 wǒ gěi nǐ dào bēi shuǐ: Let me pour you some water
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 到 dào (sound). dǎo fall (摔倒); dào pour, reverse (倒水, 倒车)

cards.Example: 欢迎你来我家！ huānyíng nǐ lái wǒ jiā: Welcome to my home!
cards.Notes: 欢 joyful + 迎 go to meet (辶) = to greet joyfully

cards.Example: 你坐我这边。 nǐ zuò wǒ zhè biān: Sit on my side
cards.Notes: 辶 walking + 力. Simplified from 邊. Suffix for place: 这边, 旁边, 左边

cards.Example: 你看新闻了吗？ nǐ kàn xīnwén le ma: Did you see the news?
cards.Notes: 新 new + 闻 heard = newly heard things, the news

cards.Meaning: to receive, accept; to put away
cards.Example: 把东西收好。 bǎ dōngxi shōu hǎo: Put your things away
cards.Notes: 攵 hand with stick + left part 丩 (sound) = to gather in, collect

cards.Example: 我们重新开始吧。 wǒmen chóngxīn kāishǐ ba: Let's start over
cards.Notes: 重 again (chóng here) + 新 new = do it anew

cards.Example: 杯子满了。 bēizi mǎn le: The cup is full
cards.Notes: 氵 water + right part (sound) = full to the brim. 满意 satisfied

cards.Example: 我想在你身边。 wǒ xiǎng zài nǐ shēnbiān: I want to be by your side
cards.Notes: 身 body + 边 side = beside one's body, close by

cards.Example: 你的答案正确。 nǐ de dá'àn zhèngquè: Your answer is correct
cards.Notes: 正 straight, correct + 确 certain (石 stone, solid) = correct

cards.Example: 你收到我的信了吗？ nǐ shōudào wǒ de xìn le ma: Did you get my letter?
cards.Notes: 收 receive + 到 arrive (result) = to receive

cards.Example: 这正是我想要的。 zhè zhèngshì wǒ xiǎng yào de: This is exactly what I wanted
cards.Notes: 正 exactly + 是 is = is precisely

cards.Example: 你接着说。 nǐ jiēzhe shuō: Go on, keep talking
cards.Notes: 接 connect, receive + 着 (ongoing) = carrying on from that

cards.Example: 这是今天的重点。 zhè shì jīntiān de zhòngdiǎn: This is today's key point
cards.Notes: 重 important (zhòng here) + 点 point = the key point

cards.Example: 你是几年级？ nǐ shì jǐ niánjí: What grade are you in?
cards.Notes: 纟 thread + 及 jí (sound) = rank, level. 年级 grade at school, 高级 advanced

cards.Meaning: to receive (a call, letter); to pick up
cards.Example: 我接到了他的电话。 wǒ jiēdào le tā de diànhuà: I got his call
cards.Notes: 接 receive + 到 arrive = to receive; also 接到人 = to pick someone up

cards.Example: 我想提高中文水平。 wǒ xiǎng tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng: I want to improve my Chinese
cards.Notes: 提 lift + 高 high = to lift higher, improve

cards.Example: 你满意吗？ nǐ mǎnyì ma: Are you satisfied?
cards.Notes: 满 full + 意 wish, intention = one's wishes filled, satisfied

cards.Example: 这里没有信号。 zhèlǐ méiyǒu xìnhào: There's no signal here
cards.Notes: 信 message + 号 sign, number = signal (phone signal too)

cards.Example: 你在我心中。 nǐ zài wǒ xīnzhōng: You're in my heart
cards.Notes: 心 heart + 中 middle = inside the heart (more literary than 心里)

cards.Example: 我弟弟上高中。 wǒ dìdi shàng gāozhōng: My brother is in high school
cards.Notes: 高 high + 中 middle (school) = upper middle school. 初中 junior high

cards.Example: 这里的空气很好。 zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn hǎo: The air here is fresh
cards.Notes: 空 empty, sky + 气 gas, air = air

cards.Example: 我们的想法相同。 wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ xiāngtóng: We think the same way
cards.Notes: 相 mutually + 同 same = the same as each other

cards.Example: 到处都是人。 dàochù dōu shì rén: There are people everywhere
cards.Notes: 到 reach + 处 place = reaching every place, everywhere

cards.Example: 我同意你的观点。 wǒ tóngyì nǐ de guāndiǎn: I agree with your view
cards.Notes: 观 view, look (见 see) + 点 point = viewpoint

cards.Example: 这是高级中文课。 zhè shì gāojí Zhōngwén kè: This is advanced Chinese
cards.Notes: 高 high + 级 level = high-level

cards.Example: 他的收入很高。 tā de shōurù hěn gāo: He has a high income
cards.Notes: 收 receive + 入 enter = what comes in, income. 入 rù, not 人 rén

cards.Example: 他是我的同事。 tā shì wǒ de tóngshì: He's my coworker
cards.Notes: 同 same + 事 work, affair = people doing the same work

cards.Example: 我对你有信心。 wǒ duì nǐ yǒu xìnxīn: I have faith in you
cards.Notes: 信 trust, believe + 心 heart = a believing heart, confidence

cards.Example: 我不是故意的。 wǒ bú shì gùyì de: I didn't mean to
cards.Notes: 故 reason, cause + 意 intention = with intent, on purpose

cards.Example: 你闻闻这个。 nǐ wénwen zhège: Smell this
cards.Notes: 耳 ear inside 门 door (门 mén also gives sound): listening at the door. Today usually 'smell'. Lookalike: 问 wèn

cards.Example: 放心吧，我没事。 fàngxīn ba, wǒ méishì: Don't worry, I'm fine
cards.Notes: 放 put down, release + 心 heart = put your heart at ease

cards.Example: 你来得正好！ nǐ lái de zhènghǎo: You came just in time!
cards.Notes: 正 exactly + 好 good = just right

cards.Example: 运动有很多好处。 yùndòng yǒu hěn duō hǎochù: Exercise has many benefits
cards.Notes: 好 good + 处 place, aspect = good points, benefits. Opposite: 坏处

cards.Example: 请重复一遍。 qǐng chóngfù yí biàn: Please say that again
cards.Notes: 重 again (chóng here) + 复 repeat, return = to repeat

cards.Example: 这是好事啊！ zhè shì hǎoshì a: That's a good thing!
cards.Notes: 好 good + 事 thing, matter = a good thing

cards.Example: 他提到了你。 tā tídào le nǐ: He mentioned you
cards.Notes: 提 lift, bring up + 到 (result) = to bring up, mention

cards.Meaning: not as good as; might as well
cards.Example: 我们不如打车吧。 wǒmen bùrú dǎchē ba: We might as well take a taxi
cards.Notes: 不 not + 如 be like = not equal to. A 不如 B = A isn't as good as B

cards.Example: 不好意思，我来晚了。 bùhǎoyìsi, wǒ lái wǎn le: Sorry I'm late
cards.Notes: 不好 not good + 意思 feelings = feel bad, embarrassed; a soft 'sorry'
